## Reply Intelligence — Slack interactivity handler
Slack button → parse → **ACCEPT**: create HubSpot meeting (→ morning-of) + associate to deal + lemlist channel-aware send + ✅ react on the card + threaded confirmation. **EDIT**: ✏️ react + threaded "handling in lemlist".

The original card stays put; state shows as a reaction + an in-thread reply. Webhook = Slack Interactivity Request URL.

# 🧠 Reply Intelligence — reply handler
Human-in-the-loop reply automation for outbound. Drafts are **never auto-sent** — the AE approves in Slack.

**A) Reply received** *(lemlist webhook)* → Claude triage (7 paths) → resolve account → Sumble tier + Exa research → find/create HubSpot deal → propose time → Claude draft → Slack approval card
**H) Slack action** *(button)* → Accept = HubSpot meeting + lemlist reply send + ✅ react + thread confirm · Edit = ✏️ hand to lemlist

Account intelligence keys off the **account domain** (not the reply email). Every call carries its native credential: Anthropic · Sumble · Exa · HubSpot · lemlist · Slack.
